0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Trail Blazers host the Phoenix Suns. Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Deni Avdija (ankle) and Micah Potter (illness) are day-to-day game-time decisions. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), and Luke Kennard (knee strain) is a day-to-day game-time decision. The Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, but they won their last meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
